author: ItzAidan
body:
Hello!
Okay well I was thinking, you know how it shows how many blocks you shot with your bow when your opponent dies or you get shot by your opponent. Well I was thinking, when you get shot off a high place, or you get shot out of the world or you shoot them off a high place or into the void can you guys put in how many blocks also? I think it would be a good idea :3 Please leave feedback.
Regards,
Aidan

replies.body: Could be classed as copying from other servers however... you only get the block range if you kill them with the arrow you shot, getting the block distance when you shoot them off a high place or into a void would be very cool! Just make sure you can toggle what bow shoots you'll see in chat.
